items.headline: Albemarle Upgrade: Can Energy Storage Recharge Lithium's Leader?
items.snippet: Albemarle reports third-quarter results on Nov. 4. Of the 26 analysts covering the stock, 16 rate it a Buy or Strong Buy. Just eight say Hold.

items.headline: Albemarle Corporation(ALB) Zacks Company Report
items.snippet: Albemarle faces persistent headwinds from weaker Energy Storage volumes, falling lithium prices, and rising supply-chain costs. Justifying our Underperform view.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral with an unchanged $130 price target. Strong BESS demand has tipped the market balance into favorable territory.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating. Argus believes supply and demand trends in the lithium market appear poised to improve into 2027.
